oracle.reason: The DataTug SQL-script exporter has no Oracle dialect yet, so DemoDB has no generated Oracle script for the pinned SQLite fixture, and no Oracle Database has loaded one. Nothing unverified is published.
oracle.followUp: Add an oracle dialect to the DataTug exporter, then pin its release, regenerate and verify a load on a real Oracle Database before declaring this cell a download.

sqlserver.reason: The pinned fixture is an SQLite conversion of the Access Northwind sample; Microsoft's SQL Server Northwind script is a different dataset revision and is not the pinned data. DemoDB's SQL Server script will be generated by the DataTug SQL-script exporter (dialect mssql, in review and not yet released) from the pinned SQLite fixture, and is published only after it has loaded and verified on a real SQL Server.
sqlserver.followUp: Pin the datatug release that carries dialect mssql in config/dialect-scripts.json, regenerate with scripts/dialect-scripts.mjs, add a SQL Server leg to served-formats-live.yml, then declare this cell a download with origin provider-script.
